provides.label: Plan and coordinate work across agents

approvals: It can't approve anything: approvals its steps need go to people with ai.approve.
errors: A plan naming an agent the person can't use, a forward dependency or too many steps is refused (the job retries once, then fails).
A step that fails is reported as failed; the others still report.
Delegation is one level deep: delegated agents can't delegate, so requests can't loop.

approvals: None: it only answers.
errors: No text model configured: the job fails with ai_not_configured.

approvals: None. Fetching public pages needs the web.fetch tool, which the platform turns on and the community grants.
errors: No documents and no pages: refused.
A citation whose quote isn't in its source is dropped and counted; the report says how many.

approvals: Writing to a repository or deploying needs its own approval and a connection that doesn't exist yet: it delivers a patch file instead.
errors: No source files: refused.
A patch that doesn't apply to the files sent is delivered marked as not applying, with the reasons.

approvals: None: it writes documents.
errors: A bug report needs logs or test output; evidence it cites must be real failure lines of those files, others are dropped.

approvals: None: it writes plans.
errors: Dependencies on unknown tasks and dependency cycles are removed and listed in the plan.

provides.label: Write articles, posts and marketing copy

approvals: None: it writes drafts; publishing them is a person's step.
errors: A draft outside the requested length is rewritten once; if it's still outside, it's delivered and marked as such.

approvals: None: images are delivered for people to use.
errors: No image-generation model configured: it delivers the design brief and image prompts only, and says so.
A generated file that isn't a PNG, JPEG or WebP image is discarded.

provides.label: Transcribe speech in audio and video

approvals: In review mode the final export waits for approval of the exact preview (bound to its SHA-256); a revision makes a new preview and voids the old approval.
Publishing outside Meldiq (social.publish) always needs its own approval and a connection that doesn't exist yet.
errors: No video file: refused before the job starts.
No media engine on the server: the job fails with media_engine_unavailable.
No speech-to-text model: the video is made without captions and says so.
A scene plan outside the footage: replaced by evenly spaced pieces, and the job says so.

provides.label: Social media posts and content calendars

approvals: Publishing (social.publish) needs approval and a connected social account; no connection exists, so posts are delivered as a content calendar.
errors: A post over its platform's limit is rewritten once; if still over, it's marked in the calendar.

approvals: Launching campaigns or changing budgets (ads.manage) needs approval and an ad account connection; none exists, so it recommends.
errors: No CSV, or no campaign and spend columns: refused with the column names it looks for.

approvals: Changing a live website (website.update) needs approval and a website connection; none exists, so it recommends.
errors: No HTML pages and no fetchable addresses: refused. Pages that can't be fetched are listed and skipped.

approvals: Changing a live store (website.update) needs approval and a store connection; none exists, so it delivers files to import.
errors: An inventory report needs a product CSV with quantities; rows without a readable quantity are listed as unknown.

provides.label: Sort customer messages by category and priority
Send replies to customers outside Meldiq

approvals: Sending a reply to a customer (support.reply_external) needs approval and a help desk connection; none exists, so it drafts.
errors: Without knowledge-base files the draft says it couldn't check the answer, and is marked for escalation.
A citation not found in the knowledge base is dropped.

provides.label: Sales outreach drafts and pipeline summaries

approvals: Updating a CRM or sending email needs approval and a connection; none exists, so it drafts and summarises.
errors: An activity summary needs a CSV export of deals or activities with a stage or status column.

approvals: None.
errors: No CSV: refused. An aggregation naming a column that doesn't exist is skipped and reported.

provides.label: Onboarding plans, policies and shift schedules

approvals: None: it writes documents and schedules for people to use.
errors: A shift schedule needs people and shifts (given, or found in the brief); shifts that can't be covered are listed as gaps, never filled with someone unavailable.

approvals: Payments and transfers (payments.execute) are never allowed for agents on this platform.
errors: No CSV, or no date and amount columns: refused with the names it looks for.

provides.label: Transcribe speech in audio and video

approvals: None: it writes minutes.
errors: A recording without a speech-to-text model configured is refused; send a transcript instead.
Recordings need the media engine (their sound is extracted as a small MP3); over 25 MB of that MP3 (about 70 minutes) is refused by the gateway's limit.

approvals: Sending email or changing a calendar needs approval and a connection; none exists, so it delivers a draft or an .ics file to add by hand.
errors: A meeting with an invalid start or a duration outside 5 minutes to 8 hours is refused.

approvals: None.
errors: Subtitles keep every cue and timing; a batch whose cues don't match is retried once, then the job fails.
Code, links and placeholders must survive translation unchanged, or that part is retried once and then fails.
